jobs.prompt: Minimalist illustration on a pure black background, clean thin white line art with no shading, white lines only, no colour at all. People, animals and objects are drawn WHITE: white bodies, white clothes, white fills, never black-filled shapes or dark silhouettes. No text, letters or captions in the image. Vertical 9:16 composition. Setting: inside a deep round stone well in thin white line art, stone walls all around, a circle of dusk sky at the top. Scene: looking DOWN into the deep well from above: far below at the bottom, an old donkey drawn all in solid WHITE, four legs, long ears stands trapped, looking up and braying with its mouth open, scared. No people.
